summary: Removes dead code from both phone apps. The Expo app drops the unused browser Google sign-in and its three native packages (expo-auth-session, expo-web-browser, expo-linking) plus the reversed-client URL scheme; the desktop credential import and token refresh are unchanged. The Android app drops unused policies, models, helpers, a colour and a duplicate icon; test-only helpers move to test sources. No user-visible behaviour changes.

desktop.reason: No desktop or backend code changed.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No desktop or backend code changed.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data, keys or migrations change. The secure-store keys for imported Google credentials are unchanged.

updateRelease.reason: Removing three native Expo packages and a URL scheme changes the native fingerprint, so the Expo app needs a new APK through mobile-release.yml, not an OTA. The Android app ships in its next ordinary release.

automated: npm run typecheck, npm test and npm run lint pass.
npm test --prefix apps/mobile and npx tsc --noEmit in apps/mobile pass.

Android :app:testDebugUnitTest and :app:compileDebugKotlin pass. The scaffold contract test fails on this branch and on main because it still pins versionCode 7 / 0.5.5; it passes only with those pins changed, and CI does not run it.
notExercised: No device run. The desktop credential import on a phone built without the removed packages is not exercised on hardware.
